title: Beurer BP Monitor Failure Rate
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring daily readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), Whoop recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings body/blood-pressure (`withings:measure`), Dexcom CGM glucose (`dexcom:egv`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export, Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, Whoop, Withings, Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=beurer:bp
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(reading_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by cuff_size
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often Beurer blood pressure reading records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each cuff size.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize reading_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per cuff size.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It regularly which parts of your Beurer blood pressure reading data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
